title: mut.channel_wang_soderstrom
mutation_directive: Lumen Prize winner — Wang & Söderström (2023 · Nordic) — 'Nest of You'. VISUAL SIGNATURE: A glossy, biomorphic 'cyber-nest' that twists and accretes around the viewer's tracked silhouette — soft 3D blobs reading as both organism and data exhaust. TECHNICAL HOOKS: Metaball-like soft spheres orbit a viewer-position attractor, sticking when slow and shedding when fast, leaving a trail of harvested-data residue — geometry: instanced soft spheres + SDF blend; palette: pearl, lavender, mercury. REF: https://lumenprize.org/2023-winners
